name: smart-view
description: Operate and master Oracle Smart View for Office from Claude, and read EPM Cloud pods through their REST APIs: read-only bridge to the user's Excel (connect once, refresh, explore dimensions and members, build ad hoc grids, open reports, check whether a member has data), read-only REST client with a cache of each cloud's cubes and hierarchies for fast lookups, VBA API, cell functions and troubleshooting.
